active_obligation: forward realization of native staged coefficient tasks, followed by readout descent on the declared observer kernels
problem: Which compatibility, reconstruction and discrimination problems are executable using the actual tetrahedral coefficient relationships?
conjecture: The native schedule admits an exact task classification by local rejection, inter-triangle disagreement and collective amplitude, with a sharp stage-address reconstruction criterion.
rivals: The 1836 supported coefficients behave as independent constraints.
Repeated native returns reveal additional input directions.
Observing both original seed faces, their complete stage records and the total norm determines the full locally admitted input.
An alignment-only probe Gx can be silently substituted for the actual aligned-stage value GLx.
risky_consequences: A fresh source reconstruction matches every archived typed coefficient.
The prefix maps are I,L,GL=N,NGL=N, not I,L,G,N.
The mutually orthogonal diagnostic dimensions are 24,11,1.
For a set of coordinate addresses observed at raw/local/aligned stages, full recovery is possible exactly when each triangle has at least two chosen coordinates.
Two distinct locally admitted inputs with equal norm and equal whole return can agree at every observed seed-face stage port.
strongest_falsifier: Construct and retain a nonzero seed-face observer-kernel vector and an equal-norm indistinguishable pair; independently verify the proposed decoder on all 36 input basis vectors and every per-triangle choice of missing coordinate.
carrier: 36 complex coefficients on the fixed twelve-centroid-triangle source realization; exact Q(sqrt(-3)) arithmetic, with identities valid after scalar extension to C
operation_language: The fixed directed schedule raw --L--> local --G--> aligned --N--> raw, including repetitions. No ability to apply G directly to raw input is assumed.
readout_language: Exact complex-linear coordinate readouts of recorded stage states and offline linear comparisons. Reading amplitudes and retaining intermediate records are declared mathematical access, not a derived physical measurement apparatus.
sensor_convention: One coordinate address is a (triangle outer-arrow label, spatial axis) pair read in each available stage copy; this is not one primitive transfer or one physical detector.
scope_limits: No classification of all geometric deformations, nonlinear tasks or arbitrary seed-reachable preparations.
No physical mass, time, quantum measurement or computation-universality conclusion.
The exact-coordinate reconstruction threshold is relative to the inherited axis frame and this readout grammar.
